core.008: The main pick for the 7900 XTX. Apache-2.0, downloads without an account. The most reliable at tool calling. The MTP file is optional: faster replies if your llama-server supports it.

core.012: Apache-2.0. Downloading needs a free Hugging Face account (approval is automatic). #1 of 12 variants in the Abliterlitics comparison: 82.2% success, KL 0.068 (little damage), same skills as the base. Keeps vision and MTP. If you already have Gemma4-12B HauhauCS it works as usual.
core.013: Greek texts and summaries (manual, outside the Router)
core.014: Greek model (ILSP), natural writing. Weaker at tools, so not the main assistant. Llama 3.1 Community licence.
core.015: bge-m3 is multilingual and good at Greek. If you load none, a local fallback is used.
core.r_fast_why: 27B = 27 billion parameters. Q4_K_M = about 4 bits per weight with minimal quality loss. UD = Unsloth Dynamic, keeps the important parts at higher precision. How: download the .gguf and pick it in the Router «Fast» slot or in llama-server. Context: start at 8192; up to 65,536 fits with -ctk q8_0 -ctv q8_0 in the extra parameters. MTP: add the MTP file and --spec-type draft-mtp --spec-draft-n-max 3, only if your llama-server supports it. On Windows 11 the right backend is Vulkan.
core.r_vision_why: mmproj = the projector that turns an image into something the model understands. Without it the model cannot see. How: in the Router «Vision» slot pick the same .gguf and in «Extra parameters» add --mmproj C:\…\mmproj-F16.gguf. If you add the same --mmproj to «Fast» too, there is no switch at all when you send a photo; it costs about 1 GB more VRAM. We used to say vision comes from Gemma 4: that was wrong.
core.r_unc_why: Uncensored / abliterated = a version of the same model with its refusals removed. KL shows how much the model changed: lower means less damage. How: pick it in the Router «Uncensored» slot; it is used only in «Private», which never goes to Groq. Keep a local copy: such models are sometimes removed from Hugging Face.
core.r_unc_alt: Fallback without a Hugging Face account. Apache-2.0. Abliterlitics: 75.6% (vs 82.2%) and gets stuck in thinking loops more often.
core.r_greek_why: Krikri was built for Greek and writes more naturally, but large general models (like Qwen3.8-27B) know more. q4_k_m (5.04 GB) is enough; if you already have q8_0, keep it. Load it in llama-server when you want Greek text.
core.r_stt_note: For Greek: full large-v3 makes fewer mistakes than turbo. MIT. Turbo is faster and smaller if speed matters more.
core.r_stt_why: WER = word error rate (lower = better). Greek: large-v3 11.9 (FLEURS) and 16.9 (Common Voice); turbo 12.8 and 20.8. How: download ggml-large-v3.bin and pick it as the whisper-server «Model» (Local servers). Language: el. Runs on Vulkan.
core.r_fit: Does it fit? «Fast» files with mmproj and MTP are about 18.8 GB; with a q8_0 KV cache and up to 64K context they fit in 24 GB. «Fast» and «Uncensored» do not fit loaded together (about 17 GB each), so the Router unloads one and loads the other when you open or close «Private». Nyx never downloads models by itself: open the page, download yourself and pick the file here.
v25.rt_nommproj: «Vision» has no --mmproj: without the mmproj file (e.g. mmproj-F16.gguf) the model cannot see images. Add to «Extra parameters»: --mmproj C:\…\mmproj-F16.gguf

v265.gvs_how:
Nyx does not modify GPU-Voice-Studio’s files.

Verified: the “GVS ctx” figure comes from GET /props (or /slots) on the server listening on port 8080 — it is the real n_ctx, not Nyx’s own setting.

Unverified (checked 10/11/2026): no public “GPU-Voice-Studio” repository was found on GitHub, so I do not know which GVS file sets -c / --ctx-size. Do not assume a known setting in the GVS UI until we locate it together.

How to find it on Windows 11:
1. Task Manager → Details → llama-server.exe. Enable the “Command line” column and look for -c or --ctx-size.
2. In %USERPROFILE%\GPU-Voice-Studio search .bat, .ps1, .json, .ini, .yaml or shortcuts that mention llama-server and ctx.
3. Change the value, stop GVS’s llama-server (or Voice Studio itself) and start it again. Recheck the Hub.
4. Do not replace the exe — only the launch command or a config file.

v266.sys_instructions:
You are the assistant of Nyx Canvas, an infinite note canvas on Windows. The user speaks English (sometimes by voice, with mistakes). You run commands on the canvas with the tools: create, open, delete, change, move, gather/group, tidy, search, show, write, summarize, suggest.
Rules: Use ids from the card list (8 characters are enough). For “delete/gather the X” you may pass a query instead of ids. Never compute dates or amounts yourself: call date_calc (e.g. “in 45 days”, “Tuesday 17/11”) or money_calc (split, sum, percent) and write exactly what the tool returned. For a reminder/countdown date you may pass the user’s phrase — Nyx converts it (Europe/Athens). Don’t ask needlessly — do the sensible action. After the actions reply briefly in English with what you did. If the user only wants a conversation/ideas, answer normally (markdown).
